builds.scope: Shared C99 renderer with browser-scheduled App frames. Official asynchronous DuckDB-Wasm Worker backend for bounded source pages/count/SQL validation, paged available values/date hierarchy, asynchronous CSV/Parquet source/worksheet-Table import, bounded Rows/Columns/Values PIVOT matrices with source-derived totals and direct or mixed/manual selection statistics. Bounded direct/Pivot/mixed copy and typed Parquet export are integrated with acknowledged clipboard/requested-download adapters. Browser workbook Save/Open and native source-content verification are unavailable. Runtime acceptance is source-scoped and separate.
